summary.longBusinessSummary: Kuwait Finance House K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides Islamic banking products and services in the Middle East, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Treasury, Retail and Private Banking, Corporate Banking, and Investment. The Treasury segment offers liquidity management, murabaha investments, and investment in debt securities, as well as exchange of deposits with banks, financial institutions, and international banking relationships. The Retail and Private Banking segment provides various products and services to individuals, as well as customized banking services to high-net-worth individuals. The Corporate Banking segment offers banking services and investment products to corporates, such as commodity and real estate murabaha finance, local leasing, wakala, and istisna'a facilities. The Investment segment manages direct equity and real estate investments. It provides current, gold, electron, wakala investment and deposit, and savings accounts; installment, consumer, auto, construction, medical care, and other financing; and debit, prepaid, and credit cards. The company also offers various deposits, letters of credit, and letter of guarantees; merchant, safe deposit box, and portfolio management services; investment funds, plans, and deposits; insurance and car leasing services; financing against cash collaterals; new and used cars; project construction and other trading services; and e-banking, telephone, and ATM services. In addition, it is involved in the provision of real estate investment, development, leasing, trading, and management services; consultancy, computer maintenance, and software services; and healthcare services. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial and investment services and solutions to individual, corporate, and institutional clients in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, NBK Wealth, Islamic Banking, Group Center, and International Banking. The company offers consumer loans, credit cards, trade finance, deposits, foreign exchange and advisory, and other related services. It also provides a full range of asset management, custody, brokerage, lending, and other customized and banking services to high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients. In addition, the company offers Islamic banking products and services; investment products; and treasury services and products. National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking and International Operations, and Treasury. It offers salary, youth, savings, current, and call accounts; fixed deposits; housing and construction, auto, furniture and appliances, health, education, short-term finance, as well as financing against deposit products; trade finance products comprising letters of credit and guarantee; and credit, debit, and prepaid cards. The company also provides consumer finance, credit cards, deposits and other branch related services to individuals and institutional customers, Murabaha, Ijarah, trade service, and other related services to business and corporate customers, as well as treasury services; and motor, home, fire and general accident, car, marine and aviation, family takaful, and medical insurance products. In addition, it handles direct investments, investment in associates, local and international real estate investment, and asset and wealth management activities; and local and international Murabaha and other Islamic financing primarily with banks, as well as manages its funding operations. Further, the company offers brokerage services to institutions and high net worth individuals; and mobile, online, and WhatsApp banking services, as well as property management services. Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P.

Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides mobile telecommunication services in Kuwait, Jordan, Iraq, Bahrain, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Sudan, and South Sudan. The company purchases, delivers, installs, manages, and maintains mobile telephone systems. It also offers WiMAX services, network consultancy and cloud solutions, and tower infrastructure services. In addition, the company invests in investment securities. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Mabanee Company K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides construction and real estate investment services in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia. It operates through Construction and Real Estate Operations; and Hotel Operations segments. The Construction and Real Estate Operations segment consists of leasing properties, real estate development, projects leasing, and construction activities. Its Hotel Operations segment provides hotel services through Hilton Garden Inn Hotel and Waldorf Astoria Hotel, Kuwait. The company is also involved in general trading and contracting; warehousing facilities; management; purchase, sale, and rental of land and properties; management of owned and leased properties; trading of equipment and construction materials; operation and management of family entertainment centers; advertising, publishing, distribution, and art production; real estate brokerage; freight forwarding; construction and operation of hospitals, medical centres, and governmental and private dispensaries; repair and maintenance of refrigerators and air purifiers; production and distribution of chilled water; and accommodation and food services. In addition, it develops mixed-use destinations; operates and manages shopping malls; and designs and manages projects. Mabanee Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Warba Bank K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Kuwait, rest of the Middle East countries, and internationally. It operates through Corporate, Retail, Treasury, Investment, and Other segments. The company offers current, salary, investment savings, family, and call accounts; credit cards; fixed deposits; and personal financing products, including auto, consumer, medical, housing, Al Wafi, transfer the debt, auto and medi cash, and health educational programs finance services. It also provides corporate banking services, such as real estate and industrial plot Ijara ending with ownership transfer, private housing finance, commodity Murabaha, and letters of credit and guarantee, as well as financing for the purchase of assets; and investment banking services, such as structured, securitization, and syndication finance services. In addition, the company offers discretionary, non-discretionary, and custody portfolio management services; online and mobile banking services; and POS devices, corporate deposit card, concierge, and payment gateway activities. Further, the company provides real estate, financial securities, and corporate management services; and partners with the brands and agencies to introduce them to the Kuwait market. Warba Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Gulf Bank K.S.C.P. provides various banking products and services to individual, corporate, and institutional customers in Kuwait. It operates through Commercial Banking, and Treasury & Investments segments. The company accepts current accounts, salary accounts, savings accounts, youth programs, Al Danah accounts, and term and time deposits. Its loan products include housing, consumer, secured cash, auto, secured, revolving term, and installment loans. The company also offers project finance, letters of credit, and letters of guarantee, as well as overdrafts, and working capital and long-term asset financing solutions. In addition, it provides digital wallets; credit, prepaid, and debit cards; investment funds, online trading, and transaction and merchant banking services; and foreign exchange, custodian/investment controller, portfolio management, GB products sales back office, bond's fiscal/paying agent, back office, public and private placements, and funds and structured products. Further, the company offers money market and treasury services; and safety deposit box, credit card facilities, ministries' salary, salary transfer, advisory, online banking, travel insurance, and other services. Gulf Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Commercial Bank of Kuwait K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to corporate and individual customers. The company operates through Corporate, International, and Retail Banking; and Treasury and Investment Banking segments. It offers salary, current, savings, on demand, base, AI Najma, and control accounts; term deposits; loans, including consumer loan, housing loan, short/long term loan, expatriate loans, and auto loan; and card, merchant, and digital services. The company also provides corporate online banking; overdrafts, short, medium, and long-term loans, import and export letters of credit, letters of guarantee and foreign exchange lines, syndicated loans, and structured and project finance; bank tariff; treasury and investment; and international credit, as well as trade finance and premier banking. Commercial Bank of Kuwait K.P.S.C. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Burgan Bank K.P.S.C. provides various banking products and services in Kuwait and internationally. The company operates through Corporate and Consumer banking; Treasury, and Investment banking; and Central office segments. It offers account products, such as current, premium, youth, and savings accounts; term deposit products, including fixed, special time, and ladder deposits; loan products comprising consumer and housing loans; credit, debit, and prepaid card products; and safe deposit boxes; provides private banking and wealth management. In addition, the company provides credit, trade, and project finance, and syndication lending; digital banking, ATMs, cash deposit machines; treasury, transaction banking, payment, and deposits employee services. Further, it also offers treasury, transaction banking, payment services. Additionally, the company also provides lending, deposits, trade services, foreign exchange, advisory services, credit and debit cards; treasury activities, investment services and management, banking with Financial Institution (FI), and money markets; liquidity and funding management, transfer pricing, and other unallocated activities; and other services. Burgan Bank K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Burgan Bank K.P.S.C. is a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

summary.longName: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, the Asia Pacific, North America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Commercial Banking, Retail and Private Banking, and Treasury and Investments. The company offers alfouz draw, salary, and savings accounts; term deposits; credit and prepaid cards, as well as digital payment solutions; housing, consumer, auto, medical loans, as well as UAE mortgage; safe deposit lockers, merchant services, and credit card limit services; and online, mobile, and telebanking, as well as cash issuing terminals and cardless cash withdrawal. It also provides structured finance, including project, acquisition, real estate development, asset-backed, and specialized sector financing, as well as syndicated loans and distribution and loan agency; commercial and mortgage loans; working capital finance; trade finance products, such as letters of credit and guarantee, as well as bill discontinuing; fx, forwards, and swaps; and cash management services comprising payment and payroll, collection, liquidity management, and trade finance services. In addition, the company offers foreign exchange; wealth management; investment advisory services; and balance sheet management, which includes money market, derivatives, propriety investment activities, assets management, and residual impact of inter-segment fund transfer pricing. It serves individual, corporate, and institutional customers. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

National Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunications services and related products in Kuwait, Algeria, Tunisia, Maldives, Palestine, and internationally. It offers airtime usage, messaging and data, and connection services; installation and configuration, internet connectivity, and television and telephony services are bundled with locked or unlocked equipment, such as router and/or set-top box; interconnection and roaming services; and value-added services, such as music and video streaming, and SMS services. The company is also involved in the purchase, supply, installation, management, and maintenance of wireless sets and equipment; and provision of mobile telephone, pager system, and other telecommunication services. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. National Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Ooredoo International Investments L.L.C.

Kuwait Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. provides cellular mobile telecommunication and data services primarily in Kuwait. The company offers voice, data, and text services, as well as roaming and internet and data communication services; IT systems license installation and its implementation related services; and sells devices. It also provides solutions under the STC name. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Salmiya, Kuwait. Kuwait Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Saudi Telecommunications Company.

GFH Bank B.S.C., an Islamic wholesale investment bank, provides investment advisory and transaction services in GCC countries, the Middle East and North Africa, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Wealth & Investment Management; Credit & Financing; and Treasury and Proprietary segments. The Wealth & Investment Management segment offers private equity and asset management services; and Islamic asset-backed and equity capital markets, Islamic financial advisory, and mid-sized mergers and acquisition transaction services. The Credit & Financing segment provides commercial, corporate, and retail banking services; and wealth management services, as well as structured investment products and project financing facilities. The Treasury and Proprietary segment offers treasury and residual investment asset services; and co-investment assets. It engages in the real estate development and investment, hospitality management, and education institution activities; and owns, manages, and leases real estate properties. GFH Bank B.S.C. was formerly known as GFH Financial Group BSC and changed its name to GFH Bank B.S.C. in April 2026. GFH Bank B.S.C. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Manama, the Kingdom of Bahrain.

National Industries Group Holding - KPSC, through its subsidiaries, engages in the building materials, petrochemicals, oil and gas services, mechanical industries, utilities, real estate, infrastructure, and financial services in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Investment, Building Materials and Contracting services, Specialist Engineering, and Hotel and IT Operations. The company offers stones and decorative, concrete pipes, ready mix, plastic, HDPE pipes, white blocks, ceramics, interlocks, cladding and mortar, paints, and lime powder, as well as owns and operates factories. It also provides investment and financial services, including advisory assignments for mergers and acquisitions, corporate defense support, restructurings, and management of client portfolios and risk architecture; and niche product and services to the oil and gas industry. In addition, the company engages in purchasing, developing, and selling properties and land; and manages and operates hotels, clubs, residential properties, resorts, sporting stores, restaurants, galleries, parks, and gardens. Further, it provides construction contracts; property maintenance; petrochemical products; engineering provision and other services for oil and gas, IT, and hotel operations industry; and sells building materials, infrastructure products, and basic chemicals. National Industries Group Holding - KPSC was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Boursa Kuwait Securities Company K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, operates the stock market of Kuwait. The company provides design, development, and processing of electronic data services related to the field of operating securities exchanges; information technology solutions; and offers advisory services. The company also provides services in the areas of real estate investment trusts, rights issue, short selling, stock swaps, ownership transfers, tender offers, and off-market trades. In addition, the company offers administrative, economic, and information technology consulting services; clearing, settlement, and depository services; and trustee services, as well as central depository and register services. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait International Bank K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides Islamic banking products and services for individual and corporate customers in Kuwait. The company operates through Commercial, Retail Estate, and International Banking; Retail Banking; Treasury and Investment Banking; and Others segments. The company offers various personal banking products and services, including youth, current, savings, black, salary accounts, and Al Dirwaza Account; Wakala, flexible, long term, and KIB term deposits; vehicle, construction material, medical, and goods Murabaha financing products; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; online and mobile banking, safety deposit box, and customs bills payment services; and travel insurance services. It also provides corporate online platform; corporate prepaid cards; call accounts; paycards; contracting and project financing; corporate financing products; real estate financing; and real estate appraisal services. In addition, the company offers property management services, including marketing and managing properties, collection of rent, online rent payment, preparing accounting reports, maintenance services, and legal services, as well as ATM services. Further, it provides liquidity management, correspondent banking, clearing, Murabaha investments, and exchange of deposits with banks and other financial institutions, as well as commodity Murabaha finance, Ijara, and Wakala and Musawama facilities. Additionally, the company is involved in the purchase and sale of properties, leasing, and other trading activities. Kuwait International Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, establishes and operates universities and colleges in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through the Higher Education and Others segments. The company offers computer programming; advertisement publication and distribution; and technology, e-commerce, and media services. It also provides diploma degrees in business administration, information technology, and engineering; content-based programs; learning solutions comprising IT, business, desktop, and language e-learning content; professional certifications and learning management systems; and consultancy services for the implementation, hosting, and administration of e-learning solutions. In addition, the company offers technical, application, and business skill courses; a cyclical pedagogical syllabus learning system; career development and job placements; and management and training services to schools. Further, it operates fledgling educational institutions. Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P. engages in providing air transportation and commercial passenger services in Kuwait, the Middle East, Central and South Asia, and Europe. It operates through the Passenger Airline Service and Terminal Operations segments. The company operates a fleet of Airbus A320 and A320neo aircraft. It also owns and operates a terminal at Kuwait International Airport. In addition, the company provides park and fly remote check-in services; and air cargo services, including general, perishable cargo services, express courier, unaccompanied bags, human remains, and dangerous goods. In addition, the company offers tourism, travel, and freight services, including land conveyance, holidays, car rentals, and other touristic activities, as well as management, marketing, and consultancy services in the aviation sector. It offers its services through its website and mobile app. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC
summary.longBusinessSummary: Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC engages in the manufacture and sale of power cables, control cables, telecommunication cables, and overhead conductors in Kuwait and the Middle East. It operates through three segments: Cable Manufacture, Investment, and Rendering Services. The company's products include medium and low voltage cables; overhead lines cables; LSZH cables; lead sheathed cables; telephone and special application cables; L.T. cable joints; domestic wires; and solar PV cables. It is also involved in investment; general trading and contracting; and sale and purchase of land and properties, as well as provision of cleaning and maintenance services. Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC was founded in 1975 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Real Estate Company K.P.S.C., a real estate company, owns, develops, and manages buildings in Kuwait, Gulf council countries, the Middle East, North America, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Real Estate, Investment, and Services. The company is involved in sale, purchase, renting out, and leasing of lands and real estate properties; preparation and implementation of studies of the private and public real estate projects directly or through mediation; trade in materials related to real estate and other works; investment in companies' shares or projects; contracting works; managing others' properties; and erect private and public buildings and projects, including malls, entertainment centers, and touristic utilities. It also engages in the acquisition, sale, and purchase of shares and bonds; provision of maintenance works related to the buildings and properties, such as civil, mechanical, and electrical works, as well as elevators and air conditioning works; organization of real estate exhibitions; and holding of real estate auctions. In addition, the company offers property management services, comprising financing, valuations, market appraisals, sales, and acquisitions; search, advisory, sales, and financial services, property and facilities management, project management, and consultancy services; consultancy and transactional services, such as leasing, sales, site search and feasibility, space analysis and optimization, price negotiation, renewal, and legal services, etc.; and hospitality services, including sourcing, conception, and implementation. Further, it provides real estate services in the residential, retail, commercial, and hospitality services sectors. Kuwait Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the automotive business in Kuwait, Iraq, Egypt, and the United Arab Emirates. The company imports, distributes, and sells vehicles and spare parts; and provides services related to vehicle inspection, repair, and maintenance. It also engages in dealership of heavy trucks; car rental and leasing; insurance brokerage; used vehicle sales; and real estate business. In addition, the company operates showrooms and service centers; as well as offers after-sales services, car valuation services, technical inspection, and vehicle registration renewal services. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Ali Alghanim Sons Holding Company K.S.C.C.

United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in Kuwait, Egypt, Lebanon, the United Arab Emirates, Syria, Oman, Bahrain, Jordan, Europe, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through four segments: Rental Operations, Hospitality Operations, Real Estate Development and Property Trading, and Contracting and Services. The company purchases, develops, manages, leases, and resells real estate properties, including retail complexes, hotels, residential properties, and high-rise office buildings, as well as lifestyle hubs and mixed-use properties. It is also involved in hospitality services; construction and contracting; facility and project management; general trading; touristic development; agricultural investment; food manufacturing; animal production; beauty services; operation of service facilities; and provision of medical care. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Mezzan Holding Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and distributes food and non-food products in Kuwait, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Jordan, Kuwait, and Iraq. The company provides cakes, biscuits, potato chips, snacks, meats, water, canned foods, and dairy products; contract catering services for short-term and long-term delivery of cooked food, as well as on site operation of food facilities and catering for one off events; sales and delivery of foods; and ancillary storage, logistics, repairs, and maintenance services and sale of non-food items. It distributes health and beauty products, medicines, medical devices, manufacturing of medicine, medical products, and consumer items; and plastic materials, lube oil, and carton for packaging. In addition, the company engages in the manufacturing and wholesale distribution of meat products and general trading in foodstuff; trading of household goods and cleaning materials; manufacturing of paper and nylon products; and recycling and trading of oil, lubricants and related products. Further, it offers storage services, security services; distributes food and beverages; and manufactures and sells pastries and cakes. The company was founded in 1940 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P. operates in the financial services, food, petrochemicals and oil services, media, real estate, and education sectors. It operates in six segments: Commercial Banking; Asset Management and Investment Banking; Media & Satellite Services; Energy; Industrial and Logistics; and Hospitality and Real Estate. The company offers commercial banking services, including retail, corporate, and private banking; treasury products; asset management and investment banking services, such as advisory and capital markets services, investment advisory and research, and wealth management; and media and satellite services, including digital satellite services, media pay TV services via satellite, cable, radio channels, and music and video streaming. It is also involved in manufacture, sale, store, export, and distribution of various aromatics, chemical and petrochemical materials, and related derivatives; oil field maintenance and drilling services; setting up projects in the oil and gas and renewable energy sector; and consultancy activities. In addition, the company engages in industrial and logistics services, such as industrial project development, food, utilities, transportation, and related supply chain services; hospitality and real estate services; dairy and foodstuff production; leasing of equipment; and manufacture of rubber and plastic materials. Further, it provides stevedoring, marine, brokerage, printing, rent management, management, property management, marketing, facilities and hotel management, research and development, touristic development, cosmetic, agricultural, medical, construction, educational, live event, and advertising services; broadcasting TV and IP streaming; managing and operating systems; and trading in electronic and satellite receiving equipment. It operates in Kuwait, rest of the GCC, rest of the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and North America. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.shortName: The Commercial Real Estate Co K
summary.longBusinessSummary: Commercial Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. engages in the real estate business in the State of Kuwait, Gulf countries, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate, Hotel, and Investment. Its property portfolio includes office towers, malls, restaurant, complexes, residential properties, and ballrooms. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Makhazen, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an aviation services company under Makhazen brand name in the Middle East and Africa. The company provides real estate, fuel logistics, airplane ground handling and cleaning services, cargo and lounge management, customs operations and management, construction and remote site services, customs consulting, and waste recycling services. In addition, it offers inventory management, order fulfilment, transportation, and warehousing and rental services; and ground handling and airport services comprising ramps, passengers, into-plane fuelling, and other aviation related services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P. manufactures and sells petrochemical products in Kuwait, other MENA countries, Asia, South America and North America, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy, Manufacturing, and Petrochemical Sector; Education and Services; and Others. It is involved in the manufacture and trade of packaging materials and plastic pipes; manufactures steel abrasive materials; produces chlorine, salt, and other petrochemical products; and provides educational and medical services, as well as investing directly and through portfolios into various sectors. The company also engages in business incubators, communications, and technology business; general trading activities; provision of transportation services; blending of chemical products; and manufacture of chlor-alkali products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC
summary.longBusinessSummary: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wealth management, credit and assets management, debt collections, and venture capital investment businesses in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Instalment credit, Investments, Financial Brokerage, and Real Estate. The company provides asset management and brokerage services, such as margin trading, non-discretionary, and custody portfolios; advises on real estate, private equity, and development investments; and venture capital services. It provides working capital, inventory replenishment, and capital assets purchases to small and medium businesses; and debt collector services. In addition, the company engages in financing services, including financing, management, and brokerage; trading in real estate activities; general trading and contracting; project management; hospitality activities; credit facilities services; investment activities; financial advisory services; consulting services; fund management; and digital currency services. The company was formerly known as International Finance Company (K.P.S.C) and changed its name to Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC in November 2013. Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Cement Company K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells cement and ready-mix concrete in Kuwait and internationally. The company offers ordinary portland cement OPC, sulphate resistant cement SRC, white ordinary Portland cement WOPC, oil well cement OWC, and ground granulated blast furnace slag material GGBS. Kuwait Cement Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Tamdeen Investment Company - KSCP is a principal investment firm specializing in management of financial investment transactions related to securities, including the acquisition and sale of private sector shares and bonds. The firm prefers to invest in financial, energy, and real estate sectors. The firm considers investments in Kuwait, Middle East and GCC countries. The firm also provides guidance and advice in various aspects of mergers, acquisitions, and leveraged buyouts and restructurings; investigates and provides reports to management regarding companies potential acquisitions, sale, or mergers; engages in the valuation of assets, divisions, and companies along with appraisal of major capital investment decision; and advices and assists clients on raising finance, as well as offers private placement and underwriting services for various projects. In addition, it provides asset management services, including custodial and trading services; and is involved in general trading and contracting, real estate, and consulting businesses. Tamdeen Investment Company  KSCP was founded in 1997 and is based in Kuwait, Kuwait with additional office in Safat, Kuwait.

Valmore Holding S.A.E. is an investment holding company specializes in private equity, Mezzanine and secondary investing. It invests in mature, emerging growth, industry consolidation, buyout and growth capital investments. It seeks to invest in oil and gas production, insurance, infrastructure services, fertilizer and agriculture chemicals, building materials, utilities, electric power generation by fossil fuels, petrochemicals, natural gas distribution and transmission, non-banking financial services and manufacturing MDF (Medium Density Fiberboard). The firm seeks to invest in Egypt, Kuwait, United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia. It invest from its balance sheet investments. The firm takes majority stake. Valmore Holding S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza, Egypt with an additional office in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Syria and United Kingdom.

IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC engages in the development, management, and marketing of hotels and resorts in Kuwait, Asia, the United Arab Emirates, Africa, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Property Development, Hospitality, Investments, and Others segments. The company offers hotel management, serviced homes, and vacation rentals services under the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts, Kempinski Hotels, Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts, and Sheraton Hotels & Resorts brands. It also purchases, develops, manages, and sells real estate properties and land; and trades in private residential plots. In addition, the company holds, purchases, and sells shares and bonds of real estate companies; provides studies and consultations on real estate issues. Further, it prepares real estate auctions; provides buildings general contracting; holds and manages commercial and residential complexes; establishes building foundations for residential, commercial, maintenance, touristic, urban, athletic buildings, and projects; and operates beach clubs. Additionally, the company offers travel and tourism services, such as personal travel consultancy, and air chartering services, as well as provides events, meetings, corporate incentive arrangements; and offers assess to private jets, yachts, and tailor-creating travel experiences. The company was formerly known as Offset Consulting and Project Management Company  WLL  Najwa Ahmed Abdelaziz Al-Qatami and Partners and changed its name to IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC in May 2005. IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC was founded in 1995 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Salhia Real Estate Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development and leasing in Kuwait, Gulf Cooperation Council, and Europe. The company operates through Real Estate Operations and Hotel Operations. It develops and leases commercial, retail and leisure, and office properties. The company also provides hotel hospitality services through JW Marriott Hotel  Kuwait, Courtyard Marriott Hotel-Kuwait and Arraya Ballroom  Kuwait, and Marriot Executive Apartments. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of project management services; and entertainment businesses. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Trolley General Trading Company K.S.C.C. operates as a convenience-led grocery retailer in Kuwait and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company engages in operating a dual format store model, Trolley and Baqala. The company owns and operates retail stores through its brands Trolley and Baqala in various locations including high-traffic urban centers, fuel stations, university campuses, and premium residential complexes. Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in Kuwait, GCC countries, and internationally. The Life and Medical Insurance segment offers savings, protection products, and other long-term contracts. National Investments Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial and investment services in Kuwait, GCC countries, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Investment; Treasury; Real Estate; and Asset Management, Advisory, and Brokerage. It trades in equities, including investment in associates and other strategic investments; engages in liquidity management and trading of foreign currencies; and buys, sells, and invests in real estate. The company also manages discretionary and non-discretionary investment portfolios, as well as investment funds; and offers brokerage, advisory, last mile delivery, and other related financial services and market making. In addition, it provides MENA securities; wealth and asset management; investment banking and advisory; online trading and brokerage; and treasury and international securities. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, provides investment and financial services in Kuwait, the GCC, and internationally. The company offers mutual funds; public placement and private placement advisory services; wealth management services; and transaction based advisory services, including business valuations, portfolio valuation, purchase price allocation and goodwill impairment, as well as strategic financial advisory, such as merger and acquisition transactions, restructurings, business modeling, change of control, going private, management buyout, and public private partnerships. In addition, the company operates Amman International Airport Hotel, a 4-stars hotel, as well as provides hospitality services and management of third-party hospitality businesses; owns and manages residential and commercial properties; provides maintenance for residential and commercial complex, entertainment centers, hotels, and tourist facilities; develops, leases, and operates real estate properties; and provides information technology solutions and services, including Oracle, Cloud, ERP and Kiosk solutions, CMS/DMS and archiving, software development and integration, manpower outsourcing and recruitment, printers and copiers consumables, and maintenance and training services. Further, it engages in general trading and contracting activities; leasing of submarine internet transmission cables; and media and advertisement services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC operates as a subsidiary of National Industries Group Holding  KPSC.

International Financial Advisors Holding - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the treasury and investments, real estate, and other businesses. The company is involved in the insurance and aviation businesses; yacht, and travel and tourism; and wealth and fund management; and portfolio and strategic investment activities. It also provides turnkey Internet, local and international data communication solutions, and termination services for foreign carriers; mechanical, electrical and plumbing (mep), infrastructure, water and power, civil contracting, and engineering services; financing credit facilities; and consumer and mortgage finance, investments, and asset management. The company was formerly known as International Financial Advisors  KPSC. International Financial Advisors Holding - KPSC was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Tamdeen Real Estate Company - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in the State of Kuwait. It operates through real estate and investment segments. The company is involved in managing, developing, selling, and purchasing land, properties, and resorts, as well as building construction; management and leasing of owned and leased properties covering residential and non-residential sectors; project management; and management and operation of hotel apartments and hotels. It also engages in the ownership of properties and movables; third-party property management services; property booking; designing, building, operating, maintaining, and transferring projects under the PPP system; organizing and managing trade exhibitions and conferences; and overseeing rest areas and multipurpose halls, such as wedding halls, conferences, and exhibitions. In addition, the company manages tourism facilities, including restaurants and cafes, as well as parks, beaches, and coasts; provides property consulting and building maintenance services; operates recreational exhibitions and markets; and manages sports facilities and provides related services. Further, it is involved in managing healthcare institutes; establishing companies or partnering with other parties; buying and selling shares and bonds; and investing financial surplus in managed portfolios. Tamdeen Real Estate Company - KPSC was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in insurance and reinsurance operations in Kuwait. It operates through Non-life insurance, Life insurance, Reinsurance, and Investments segments. The company offers property insurance, marine and aviation insurance, personal accident and fire, as well as annuity and term life contracts. Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Gulf Investment House - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment activities in Kuwait, Gulf and the Middle East, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Investments; Real Estate; and Manufacturing. It provides financial and advisory services. It also undertakes Islamic investments, as well as engages in the real estate activities. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Gulf Investment House - KPSC operates as a subsidiary of GIH Financing Co.

summary.longBusinessSummary: Al-Maidan Clinic for Oral Health Services Company K.S.C.P. provides oral health care services in Kuwait. It operates through Clinics, Hospital, and Capital segments. The Clinics segment operates clinics that offer services relating to oral health care, diagnosis, consultations, and treatment to outpatients with a specialty in dental treatment. The Hospital segment operates hospitals, which provide services related to medical diagnosis, health care, consultations, surgical and treatment to outpatients and inpatients with various specialties. The capital segment is involved in sale and purchase of land and real estate properties; investing in financial portfolios; management of real estate property; and other activities. The company offers dental services, including prosthodontics and cosmetic, dental implants and periodontics, orthodontics, pedodontics, endodontic restorative services, conservative services, dental hygiene, and sterilization services. It also engages in shares and real estate trading activities; building and management of specialized medical centers; and contracting with doctors, nurses, and technicians. In addition, it provides maintenance services for medical devices and equipment; conducts studies and researches related to the field of dentistry and contracting; establishes and manages specialized laboratories; dentistry and medical house services; purchases medical devices and equipment; owns properties; and undertakes transportation activities. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Al-Maidan Clinic for Oral Health Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Medical Services Company K.S.C.

summary.longBusinessSummary: Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula Power and Water Company KSC (Public) develops, constructs, owns, and operates power and water plants in Kuwait. It produces and supplies water and power to the electrical energy, national power and water. Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula Power and Water Company KSC (Public) was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Action Energy Company K.S.C (Public) provides oil well drilling services in Kuwait. The company offers drilling and workover, upstream, manpower, and workshop services. It engages in the maintenance of oil facilities, wells, and oil and petrochemicals facilities. The company was formerly known as Action Energy Company - Rawaf Ibrahim Hamoud Bourisli and Partners W.L.L. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail finance sector in Kuwait. The company offers cash, auto, housing, education, marine, furniture, electrical, and commercial loans; and short- and medium-term loans to individuals and entities for financing the purchase of vehicles, equipment, and home appliances, as well as land and properties. It also finances consumer products of raw materials, manufactured, or semi-manufactured; invests in real estate, industrial, agricultural, and other economic sectors; and purchases and sells financial securities, such as shares and bonds. In addition, the company acts as an intermediary in managing loans and syndicated loans; and manages investment portfolios. Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Combined Group Contracting Company - K.S.C. (Public), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a contracting company in State of Kuwait and other Gulf countries. The company offers construction, general contracting, and renovations of residential and non-residential buildings, nonindustrial, railway facilities, and airports; and hospitals, free zones or markets, cooling warehouses, buildings, precast houses, roads, pavements, bridges, tunnels, and infrastructure works. It is also involved in laying of communication and power lines, oil, liquefied petroleum gas, steam, fire, irrigation, and electrical and telecommunications wiring and networks; construction, maintenance of main lines and water distribution stations, irrigation and sewer systems, water wells drilling, sewage disposal plants, pumping stations and power plants; parking lots, outdoor swimming pools, refineries, petrochemical plants, port docks, marine structures, tourist marinas, and dams; and demolition, removal, site preparation, pouring foundations, dewatering, and rocks and rocky ground blasting services. In addition, the company builds finishing; installs lighting systems, fire alarms and other electrical installation, solar energy collectors, emergency and exit lighting, cooling systems, sanitary wares, and mechanical installations; ceramic, terrazzo, marble, cut stone, granite, marble, carpets, and linoleum floor coverings, and rubber or plastic, and parquet, and decorations; and exterior glass of towers, interiors of shops, mobile homes, boats, furniture and exterior cladding. Further, it is involved in plastering or stucco, and painting works; maintaining oil pipes; building completion and preparation work, bricklaying and stone setting works, and scaffolding erecting; contracting for insulating materials and protection materials; and import of aggregate. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. The company operates as a subsidiary of Insha'a Holding Company.

National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides real estate and investment services in the Middle East and North Africa. The company is involved in ownership, development, trading, leasing, and management of real estate properties and other activities. It also sells, and purchases land and real estate properties; manages third-party properties and public facilities; constructs residential buildings; real estate consulting; operates exhibitions and entertainment markets; sells and purchases stocks and bonds; repairs and maintains air conditioning, refrigeration, and air purification equipment; and trade fairs organization and management. In addition, the company engages in the design, construction, operation, maintenance, and transfer of projects; auctions; operates and manages hotel and restaurant; and investing in activities. National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) provides building materials, and construction and engineering services in Kuwait, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. It operates through Industrial Operations, Real Estate Operations, and Contracting Operations segments. The company manufactures autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) products, including AAC slabs, construction blocks, panels, lintels, dry mortars, and other AAC reinforced structural components; ground granulated blast furnace slag, ordinary Portland and sulfate resistant cement, white cement, micro silica, and cement block products; and ready-mix concrete and interlock products. It also provides precast products; project management, construction and management, contracting and subcontracting, infrastructure project, engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as maintenance services for civil works, electrical, plumbing, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning. In addition, the company owns, develops, and manages real estate properties in the Gulf region. Further, it engages in the transportation and delivery of various products through a fleet of machinery and heavy equipment, as well as offers integrated construction services with turnkey building solutions for citizens looking to build homes. ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. engages in financial investments, trading and investment properties, and leasing activities in the State of Kuwait. It operates through Islamic Financing, Leasing Sector, Real Estate Management, Proprietary Investment and Assets Management, and Others segments. The company offers lease financing services; acts as financial intermediary and broker; grants credit facilities to consumers; and participates in the establishment of companies, as well as deals in the shares of the companies on its behalf and on behalf of third parties. It is also involved in the marketing of products and services; portfolio management on behalf of the customers; investment in real estate properties in industrial, agricultural, and other sectors; and development and rental of residential land and commercial properties. In addition, the company conducts research and studies, and related activities on behalf of customers; establishes investment funds; and manages funds. Further, the company engages in the buying and selling of real estate; investment securities; leasing of vehicles and equipment; and provision of logistic services. A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. engages in the provision of various upstream oilfield services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Oil field, and Non-oil field services segments. The company offers upstream oil services that include cementing, down hole tool, completion, directional drilling, well logging services, hydraulic fracturing, coiled tubing, and well stimulation services; environmental and sustainability services, such as environmental and safety services; quality, health, safety, and environmental services. It also provides drilling and maintenance of oil wells and chemical waste management; petrochemical activities; and support activities for petroleum and natural gas mining incidental to onshore and offshore oil and gas extraction. In addition, the company offers support services for well drilling, repairing and preparation for production, well maintenance-related services; importing and owning machines, tools and materials; owning lands and real estate necessary for establishing facilities and equipment; obtaining and granting agencies; and importing and exporting chemicals. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Al Ahmadi, Kuwait. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

summary.longBusinessSummary: Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction contracting company in Kuwait. It operates in three segments: Industrial, Oil & Gas; Shipyard; and Offshore. The company is involved in the construction and repair of ships; marine, industrial, installation, and maintenance works related to ships, waterways, and ports; trading in equipment, spare parts, and industrial consumables; acting as an agent for trading agencies; industrial inspection works and radiation services; and maintenance, repair, and public services for transport lines, oil and gas tankers, refineries, factories, and annexes, as well as projects and stations of electrical power generation and distribution, water sources, and water and electricity establishments safety. It also supplies, installs, and maintains safety equipment and security systems; provides, installs, and maintains establishments, equipment, machinery, and devices, as well as supplies specialized technical manpower for works related to the electricity, water, oil, and environment sectors; undertakes contract works for laying and installation of pipes, and fine cutting works through using plasma and water; engages in sandblasting, paint and fixed, mobile scaffolds, and welding; provides galvanization works; acquires movables and real estate; and owns intellectual property rights comprising patents, trademarks, and franchise rights. In addition, the company engages in dredging, marine, and civil construction activities; shipyard, oil and gas construction, industrial maintenance, fabrication service, and onshore and offshore operations; electrical and mechanical works; diving and afloat/port repairs; and testing and calibration services. Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Reinsurance Company K.S.C.P. provides reinsurance services in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Non-Life Reinsurance and Life Reinsurance. The company provides fire, general accident, and marine and energy policy reinsurance for risk coverage on damage and loss to residential, commercial, and industrial property; person and property; and cargo and ships. It also offers life reinsurance, risk coverage on loss caused due to death. In addition, it provides treaty; engineering; casualty; downstream, upstream, and renewable energy; and Retakaful reinsurance products and services. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Kuwait Reinsurance Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Al Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P.

Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P. provides various insurance products and services in Kuwait. It operates through Marine and Aviation, Fire, General Accident, Motors, and Life Insurance segments. The Marine and Aviation segment provides insurance against risks related to goods transportation, and different types of marine and aviation vessels. The Fire segment offers insurance against fire for various types of buildings and stores; industrial risks; and oil and gas industry. The General Accident segment offers insurance against risks of contractors, machinery and computer damages, and cessation of work; and insurance cover for cash, bonds, fidelity, professional risks, work accidents, and civil responsibility. The Motors segment provides insurance against motor vehicles including third party liability coverage. The Life Insurance segment provides life insurance cover for individuals and groups, as well as medical insurance products. In addition, the company provides takaful insurance. Further, it offers travel, home, boat, and yacht and jet ski insurance. Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading and marketing of crude oil and petroleum products in the United Kingdom, Singapore, Sudan, Kenya, Africa, the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Kuwait, and internationally. The company is involved in logistics activities; and owns and operates petroleum products tankers. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C), together with its subsidiaries, establishes and operates cinemas in Kuwait and internationally. The company operates through Cinema and Buffets, Financial Investment, and Investment Properties segments. It establishes, operates, and leases shops, restaurants, ready-made meals, coffee shops, and fun games halls in cinema and theatre buildings; owns movable assets; and manages and operates visual and audio media, as well as retail sales of gifts and accessories. The company also engages in publishing and film production, as well as distribution activities. In addition, it imports, produces, and distributes movies of different genres and sizes; and exports, leases, and sells. Further, the company invests in equity and investment funds; and invests in and rents real estate properties. Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait

The company engages in the acquisition, establishment, leasing, operation, and maintenance of petrol stations. It also provides gasoline, diesel fuel, and kerosene, as well as oil and lube products. In addition, the company offers automobile services related to cars and vehicles, such as oil changing, car washing, maintenance workshop, and technical check-up services; ships and trades in petroleum products in bulk or retail; and prepaid and postpaid petro cards for public, private, and government sectors, as well as operates soft drinks vending machines at fuel stations. Further, the company purchases, leases, acquires, and sells land and real estate properties; and invests in managed portfolio, short-term money market placements, and real estate. Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. The company operates as a subsidiary of Alfa Energy Company K.S.C.

Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, establishment, leasing, operating, and maintenance of petrol stations in Kuwait. It operates through two segments, Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services; and Investments. The company also provides automobile services, including oil change, car wash, maintenance workshop services, and technical check-ups; prepaid fuel cards and related electronic services; various account cards for individual and corporate customers; and oulaE Tag, a smart system for fuel payment and other services in the oula station. In addition, it offers logistics, marketing, and consultancy services. Further, the company is involved in the purchase, renting, owning, and selling of lease lands and real estate; trade in petroleum products in bulk or retail; operation of central markets; and investment in financial and real estate portfolios. Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Beyout Holding Company K.S.C. (Public), through its subsidiaries, provides human resources and project lifecycle support services. The company operates through Real Estate and Services segments. The Real Estate segment engages in owing, selling, purchasing, managing, developing, and trading in real estate. The Services segment provides administrative labor, HR-related services and certain other activities. It is also involved in property leasing, general trading, housing, entertainment, human resources management, logistic and support, travel and tourism, and contracting services. Beyout Holding Company K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides various investment and financial products and services in Kuwait, Other GCC countries, Other Middle East and North Africa, Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company operates through four segments: Asset Management, Direct Investments and Corporate Finance, Treasury, and Other Operations. It offers portfolio management services, including customized portfolio management; access to IPOs; and local, regional, and international fund management services. The company also provides fund management services for individuals and corporations; direct investment services that manage and monitor a diversified portfolio of mid- to long-term direct investments; online trading services through its KIC Trade platform; and treasury services comprising foreign exchange trading and money market activities. In addition, it engages in the management of long-term strategic investments, lending, real estate, and rental activities. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Investment Authority.

Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P. operates a logistics company in Kuwait and internationally. The company offers equipment leasing and hiring services; heavy lifting services, including specialized lifting, and engineering and rigging services; heavy transport haulage services, such as various trucks, trailers, and equipment; and alternative lift services comprising gantry system, and jacking and skidding services. It also provides earth moving services, including demolition and construction activities; industrial equipment services comprising air compressors, welding machines, tower lights, man lifts, and tele handlers; and rig move services, such as drilling rig and super rig move, work over, casing, and heavy haulage. In addition, the company offers energy services for temporary project location, including generators, transformers, fuel tanks, load banks, synchronizers, and totals panels; shutdown management services; and tower cranes for residential and commercial, civil construction, high-rise building infrastructure, bridges and flyovers, and other construction projects. Further, it provides port operations services, such as handling of aggregates, pet coke, clinker, gypsum rocks, coal, steel scrap, direct reduced iron, hot briquetted iron, general cargo, and jumbo bags; other services that include hopper system, weigh bridge operation, and port information management services; and general trading and contracting services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Advanced Technology Company K.S.C.P. provides healthcare and environmental solutions in Kuwait. The company offers diagnostic imaging and radiotherapy products; medical technologies, and dialysis and health facility infrastructure; laboratory and environmental solutions; automated pharmacy systems and modular furniture for inpatient, outpatient, and emergency pharmacies; and OR integrated solutions, consumable supplies, and disposable solutions. It also provides disinfection and sterilization equipment; patient care and rehabilitation, and medical furniture; and specialized equipment, instruments, materials, and consumables for dental clinics and labs. In addition, the company offers pharmaceuticals, aesthetic products, medical devices, hospital consumables, and disinfectants; animal health, veterinary, agriculture, crop protection, and irrigation products; and wellness and healthcare apparel products. Further, it provides information solutions, such as hospital management systems, electronic medical records, clinical decision support systems, IT strategic consulting, process mapping, clinical workflows, education, training, and other related services; and structured cabling, converged and wireless networking, IP telephony, video conferencing, enterprise datacenters, enterprise storage, disaster recovery and business continuity, security, and cloud and virtualization environment building solutions. Additionally, the company offers kitchen and laundry equipment, including cooking equipment, dishwashers, meal delivery and ventilation systems, laundry equipment, and insulated trays for hospitals, hotels, catering services, and restaurants; and security, surveillance, and access control solutions, as well as home care nursing and physiotherapy services. It serves government and private hospitals, dental practitioners, laboratories, and physicians. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Salmiya, Kuwait.

It operates through three segments: Real Estate, Investments, and Services. The company offers real estate investment and development, management of real estate funds, as well as real estate evaluation, cleaning services for buildings and real estate properties, and security and guarding services for buildings. It also owns, manages, operates, invests, rents, and leases hotels, clubs, health clubs, motels, entertainment houses, rest houses, parks, fairs, restaurants, cafeterias, compounds, tourist facilities, health resorts, sports, and entertainment projects, as well as shops. In addition, the company is involved in the development, purchase, sale, and management of properties and land; execution and maintenance of civil, mechanical, and electrical contracting activities; and owns commercial markets and residential compounds, as well as general trading and contracting, and air conditioning and refrigeration business. Further, it offers development of infrastructure projects for residential, commercial, and industrial areas under the BOT system; trades in financial instruments; imports, sells, and installs various safety and firefighting equipment; and organizes real estate exhibitions. Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

National Industries Company - KPSC engages in the manufacturing and marketing of building and construction materials and infrastructure products in Kuwait, the GCC, and the Middle East. The company offers ready mix; concrete pipes; paints, such as texture acrylic coating, solvent-based paints, water-based paints, and other paints; interlock, yard tiles, kerbstone, garden benches, and flowerpots; cement cladding and limestone bricks; cladding bricks and materials; and mansory blocks. In addition, the company is involved in oil and gas wells operations and services, construction and contracting, and buying and selling land and real estate. National Industries Company - KPSC was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells chlor alkali products in Kuwait, other countries in the Middle East and North Africa, Asia, South America, North America, and internationally. It operates through Chlor Alkali, Petrochemical Products, Trading, Logistics and Transport, Industrial Projects, and Investments segments. The company offers caustic soda, chlorine, ferric chloride, sodium hypochlorite, purified food grade salt, hydrochloric acid, and hydrogen. It also engages in the provision of logistics and transportation services; construction of chlorine dioxide plant for groundwater reservoirs; distribution of industrial materials; production and sale of petrochemical products; and investment activities. In addition, the company is involved in the import, storage, and distribution of cement and other bulk materials; establishing, operating and managing storage silos; and production of steel drums and other petrochemical products. It serves potable and wastewater treatment plants, power plants, oil refinery, petrochemical, oil drilling, industrial, food, and pharmaceutical industries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

summary.longName: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. provides ports management, warehousing leasing, contract logistics, and equipment leasing services in Kuwait and rest of GCC. The company offers container handling, RORO, heavy lift, break bulk vessels, and aggregate cargo handling; handling of container terminal and general cargo; transportation; reefer plugging facility; and other services, including weighbridge, general transportation and project logistics, and ERP management system. In addition, the company involved in land and pipeline transport; transport of refrigerated and frozen goods, liquids, liquefied gases, chemicals, and cars; solid and liquid waste; and vehicle transport rental. Further, it owns, sales, leases, and rents ground equipment for aviation services; and act as marine shipping and transport agencies, as well as provides vehicle, chemical, furniture and wood, and refrigerated and frozen goods warehousing services. Additionally, the company provides ship, land, sea unloading and loading, and ground and technical services at airports. The company was formerly known as Jassim Transport & Stevedoring Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. in November 2024. summary.longBusinessSummary: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, and Egypt. The company operates through Real Estate, Hotels, and Investment segments. It is involved in commercial real estate activities, such as purchase and sale of lands and properties. The company also involved in the establishment, acquisition, and management of hotels; and tourism activities. In addition, it invests in shares and share capital of the companies. Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Al Safat Investment Company K.S.C. is a Shariah-compliant privately owned investment manager. The firm also provides financial and consulting services to its clients. The firm is specializing in acquisition, SMEs, buyouts and growth capital investments. It is also a venture capital capital firm specializing in startup. It primarily provides its services to institutional and individual investors. The firm manages client focused portfolios and investment funds for its clients. It invests in the public equity, fixed income, and alternative investment markets across the globe. The firm's alternative investments include investments in private equity and real estate markets. It conducts in-house research to make its investments. The firm invests in various sectors such as services, medical sector, energy, financial investments, real estate, healthcare, Takaful insurance, information and technology, travel and tourism, food/beverages and consumer goods/agriculture, education, and industrial sectors. It prefers to invest in Islamic funds market, Kuwait, GCC or MENA region. It prefers to take majority stake in companies. Al Safat Investment Company K.S.C. was founded on September 15, 1983 and is based in Hawally, Kuwait with an additional office in Safat, Kuwait.

Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the asset management and investment banking in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through three segments: Asset Management, Investment Banking, and Others. The company offers asset management services, such as funds and market making, as well as discretionary, non-discretionary, and advisory services portfolio management; and investment banking solutions, including equity capital markets and debt capital markets, IPOs, listings, capital structure advisory, restructuring, disposition services, and mergers and acquisitions advisory. It is also involved in real estate management comprising acquisition, management, and disposal of properties; provision of wealth management solutions, and research and consulting services. Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides wealth management, forward trading, access to IPOs, and advisory services to its clients. It provides its services to individual, institutional clients, ultra-high net worth individuals, high net worth clients, family offices, sovereigns, endowments, foundations, and corporate. The firm manages customized portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. The firm prefers to invest in companies having enterprise value of at least $100 million invests at least $5 million in companies. It makes its investments in the securities of companies operating across diversified sectors.
