KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was founded in September 28, 1998 and is based in Sharq, Kuwait. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Gulf Bank B.S.C. (E.C.).

summary.longName: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a real estate company in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate, Entertainment, and Investment. The Real Estate segment invests and trades in real estate properties; constructs or develops real estate properties; and offers other related real estate services. The Entertainment segment owns and operates cinemas; and leases cinemas to various customers. The Investment segment participates in equity securities of real estate companies and funds. The company also buys, rents, leases, and sells real estate properties inside and outside of Kuwait; establishes and maintains buildings and real estate projects, including residential complexes; and establishes commercial markets, entertainment centers, touristic facilities, and building accommodations. It also undertakes contracting works; and trades in building materials. Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the ownership, development, sale, and purchase of real estate properties in Kuwait and internationally. The company also owns, operates, manages, leases, rents, and invests in hotels, clubs, motels, entertainment houses, rest places, gardens, parks, exhibitions, restaurants, cafes, commercial complex, residential compounds, touristic and health spas, entertainment and sports facilities, stores, and appended facilities, as well as offers real estate consultancy services. Additionally, it is involved in the maintenance works for buildings and real estate properties, such as civil, mechanical and electrical, and elevator and air conditioning works; and organizing real estate exhibitions related to the real estate projects and auctions, as well as develops and manages real estate investment funds. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiary, National Company for Aggregate Import & Sale W.L.L, trades in construction materials in Kuwait. It operates through Cement, Steel, Aggregate and Ready Mix; and Investments segments. The company is involved in the import and sale of aggregates; transportation of liquids, liquid gases, chemicals, and solid and liquid waste; extraction, reprocessing, and packaging of sand; processing of construction waste; processing and disposal of non-hazardous wastes; warehousing and storage; chemical storage; retail sale of construction materials and scraps; and gravel crusher activities. It also distributes ready-mixed concrete, cement, gypsum, bricks, tiles, ceramics, marbles, building materials, metallic construction materials, plumbing and heating supplies, sand, gravel, steel, blacksmithing supplies, and related materials and equipment; and holds properties and movable assets. In addition, the company manufactures and sells prefabricated and ready-mix concrete, and cement bricks; invests in financial surpluses in financial portfolios managed by specialized companies or entities; buys and sells shares, bonds, and motor vehicles; operates car repair garages, auto bodywork workshops, and car painting and coating workshops; and imports gravel and chemicals. Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and investment businesses in Kuwait and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Project Management, Investments, Property Management, and Others. It owns, manages, operates, invests, rents, and leases hotels, health clubs, tourist facilities, restaurants and cafeterias, residential complexes, shops, and sports projects; designs, develops, implements, and manages infrastructure, residential, commercial, and industrial projects; and establishes and invests in factories, companies, and engineering laboratories. The company also engages in real estate contracting business; trading of construction materials and building supplies; maintenance services of buildings; exploitation of investing surplus funds in portfolio; and obtaining brands. In addition, it is involved in various real estate services; financial, legal, and technical and maintenance issues; operational expenses settlement; and real estate consultancy and report services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P.
summary.longBusinessSummary: Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. operates as an investment and finance company in Kuwait. It operates in four segments: Financing, Investment, Real Estate, and Education. The company grants real estate, industrial, all other types of loans, and short, medium, and long term loans to individuals and corporate to finance the purchase of land and properties, and to companies and institutions to finance their activities against securities; and manages a range of investment portfolio and collective investment schemes, as well as involved in investment of surplus funds and securities, leasing service, wholesale, gifts and accessories, mediation in lending and borrowing operations, financing and mediation in trade operations, and health care services. It is also involved in general trading activities; organization of public auctions; provision of educational services; and trades, develops, and manages real estate projects, as well as operates and manages schools. The company was formerly known as Housing Finance Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. in December 2016. Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, develops, promotes, acquires, and invests in real estate, financial, and industrial projects in Kuwait, Morocco, Syria, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Academic and Investments. It offers various academic activities, including curriculum development, course delivery, and academic research, as well as creates, organizes, and delivers educational programs to students. The company also engages in investment portfolios and investments in non-financial assets held for capital appreciation. In addition, it is involved in real estate and trading businesses. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

summary.longName: Injazzat Real Estate Development Company K.P.S.C.

Its investment activities involves land trading, which includes buying parcels of land for direct resale, or to be split into sub-plots and sold to one or more buyers. The firm co-invests with partners who bring added value or specific experience in a particular type of project. Injazzat Real Estate Development Company was founded in 1998 and is based in Safat, Kuwait.

First Investment Company K.S.C.C. is a Shariah compliant privately owned investment manager. The firm also provides treasury services to its clients. First Investment Company K.S.C.C. was formed on July 26, 1997 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C., together with its subsidiary, engages in the general insurance business in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and internationally. The company offers fire, general accident and engineering, group life, marine cargo, and marine hull and aviation and special contingency; motor third party and motor comprehensive and extended warranty; medical; education and protection and savings; travel; home; and life insurance products. It also manages general and family takaful activities and investments. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Manama, the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.

Al-Deera Holding Company K.P.S.C. is a private equity firm specializing in direct and fund investments. The firm seeks to make buyout investments in the public equity markets. The firm prefers to invest both locally and globally through its subsidiaries. The firm prefers to take majority stakes. It seeks to invest in both public and private companies. Al-Deera Holding Company K.P.S.C. was founded on February 18, 1998 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

In addition, the company offers branded generic pharmaceuticals; IT, professional audio visual, and enterprise software solutions to the public and private sectors; and specialized graduate studies from a university. Further, it engages in the grinding and packaging of spices, grains, and herbs; real estate investment and facility management; management of Al Dhow tower; and provision of oil and construction services. SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C engages in the real estate business in Kuwait and internationally. The company is involved in the Owning, sale, and purchase of real estate and lands; development of properties inside and outside Kuwait; property management services; owning, sale, and purchase of shares and bonds of real estate entities; establishing and managing real estate funds; investing surplus funds in financial and real estate portfolios; preparation of economic feasibility studies; real estate consultancy services; managing, operating, investing in, renting, and leasing commercial properties, residential complexes, hotels, clubs, motels, guest houses, health clubs, touristic facilities, resorts, parks, gardens, showrooms, restaurants, cafeterias, recreational and athletic projects, and retail stores; maintenance works for buildings including civil, mechanical, electrical, elevator, and air conditioning services; organizing real estate exhibitions; holding real estate auctions; infrastructure development using Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) system; management of real estate facilities through BOT system; and participation in or acquisition of entities with similar business activities. Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) provides life and non-life insurance products and services in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: General Risk Insurance, Life and Medical Insurance, and Investment. It offers insurance against risks related to goods transportation, and various marine and aviation vessels; insurance against risks of contractors, machine and computer damages, and cessation of work; insurance for cash, fidelity bonds, professional risks, work accidents, civil responsibility, and cars; insurance against fire for buildings, stores, industrial risks, and oil and gas industries; and insurance against accidents for motor vehicles. The company also provides life and health insurance products for individuals and companies; and reinsurance services. Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

It offers road and infrastructure services, such as road and highway construction projects, as well as related services comprising storm water drainage, sewer systems, water networks, telephone networks, and road marking and signs; and drainage pipeline maintenance services. In addition, the company provides engineering products, including asphalt, polymer-based bitumen, and ready-mix concrete, as well as scaffolding services and equipment rental; and constructs, installs, and maintains water facilities, such as treatment plants for drinking water for homes and large buildings, swimming pools, water features, and spa facilities. Further, it supplies and installs passenger and freight elevators, escalators, moving walks, dumbwaiters, and elevators; and offers marble and natural stone products and services, as well as electrical related products and supporting services, such as Substation, switchgear, and bus ducts; Power cabling works and communication cabling of copper and fiber system networks; Power, lighting, and lighting control system; room control system; telephone, data, fire alarm, CCTV, MATV, public address (PA), and intruder detection system (IDS); and street lighting and emergency power supply solutions. Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. The company is involved in the marketing and sales management services; project management services; property management services; portfolio management services; medical services; and real estate brokerage and research services. Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P. engages in the manufacturing of iron and other metal products in Kuwait. It operates through the Manufacturing and Investment segments.
